summary: Practise decision-focused briefings, slide storyboards, evidence checks, and executive Q&A. Explore the five-day course and build presentation skills.
lede: Executive presentation training helps project leads, subject specialists, and managers turn complex updates into clear briefings for decision-makers. You’ll practise framing a decision request with BLUF and SCQA, organizing a logical slide story, selecting and checking evidence in Excel charts, and responding to questions with PREP and STAR. You’ll also rehearse a briefing and define its follow-up action.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course suits professionals who prepare recommendations, project updates, or performance briefings for executive decision-makers and need a repeatable way to make the message clear.
prerequisites: No coding or programming is required. Familiarity with routine workplace presentations is useful; you may bring a current briefing or recommendation to use during practice.
